name: Dropbox
description: Dropbox connector for file listing, search, text reads, uploads, temporary links, and citation deep links. Uses PKCE offline OAuth; local mode accepts a generated access token.

DROPBOX_CLIENT_ID.label: App Key
DROPBOX_CLIENT_ID.help: Dropbox app key (OAuth client ID). Not needed when using Eliza Cloud OAuth.

DROPBOX_CLIENT_SECRET.label: App Secret
DROPBOX_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Dropbox app secret (OAuth client secret). Not needed when using Eliza Cloud OAuth.

DROPBOX_REDIRECT_URI.label: OAuth Redirect URI
DROPBOX_REDIRECT_URI.help: Redirect URI registered on the Dropbox app.

DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access Token
DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Local BYO access token for self-hosted mode. Short-lived tokens without a refresh token stop working when they expire.

owner.notes: The user's Dropbox account, connected via PKCE offline OAuth with read scopes by default and an explicit write-scope escalation.
